_comment: TC-A #15 -- cross-surface package-equity parity (Trade Calculator completion,
in BOTH languages, through every surface that publishes an adjusted package gap:
Every expectation is derived in closed form from the ACTIVE model, NOT captured
U(side)     = sum_i q**i * v_i over positive values sorted descending, q = 0.78
vaRecipient = the side that discarded LESS depth
adjustedGap = (sum(A) + vaA) - (sum(B) + vaB)    (A minus B; == U(A) - U(B) up to rounding)
Sign conventions per surface (each test states its own mapping):
sideA is what the 'selected team' SENDS, sideB what it RECEIVES, so
equity_verdict.vaAdjustedGap == -adjustedGap and a history grade's netAdjusted
for the side that gave A == -adjustedGap.
Regenerate only when the active model deliberately changes (owner approval).

intentionalDifferences.difference: prices assets on the RETAIL market value (KTC Market for offense + picks, IDPTradeCalc for IDP), not on rankDerivedValue; and applies NO package adjustment unless every asset in the pairing has a market price (finder_value_adjustment._adjustment_for).
intentionalDifferences.why: the finder is an arbitrage engine between our board and the market; the market number is load-bearing (CLAUDE.md Trade Engines). Same math for the same numbers -- asserted here.

intentionalDifferences.difference: feeds each VENDOR's own values, not canonical ones, through the same active-model adjustment.
intentionalDifferences.why: it answers 'this source's prices plus our adjustment'. Same math for the same numbers -- asserted here.

intentionalDifferences.difference: leaves unpriced assets (value None/<=0) and owned picks the sender is proven not to hold OUT of the package math; the /trade meter refuses a verdict on an unpriced asset and counts a not-held pick (hypothetical calculator, owner decision 2026-10-03).
intentionalDifferences.why: MISSING IS NEVER ZERO / the calculator is hypothetical. Not exercised by these fully priced, pick-ownership-free cases.

intentionalDifferences.difference: only the JS calculator models them (computeSideFlows / tradeImbalance nets); no Python surface prices a 3+-team pairing.
intentionalDifferences.why: the War Room and engines are 2-side only (TC-B scope). These cases are 2-side.

intentionalDifferences.difference: equity_verdict and _va_gap round the gap to an integer; the JS headline keeps the raw float sum plus the integer adjustment.
intentionalDifferences.why: with integer inputs (every canonical value is an integer) the two are identical; the fixture uses integer values.

intentionalDifferences.difference: price external calculators with the KTC model by design.
intentionalDifferences.why: 'what KTC says' is a KTC question; not a canonical-equity surface, so not in this fixture.
